## Accepted partial result, attempt 1/5

Problem 30002481 / OWR-12862-007, rank 1242. The full implication from lightface coanalytic determinacy to the full coded sharp over set-theoretic Z3 remains unresolved by this work.

The complete authored proofs and mathematical audit establish:

1. Internal lightface analytic/coanalytic duality by a dummy move, without adding real payoff parameters.
2. Internal power-set/Hartogs/cardinal barriers, with the explicit existing-continuum-cardinal convention and CH qualification. Ambient V cardinals and L[x] cardinals remain distinct.
3. An external transitive same-reals model-transfer theorem, including the complete H_(c+) Collection argument and conditional no-new-real consequences.
4. A conditional externally countably closed embedding lemma yielding the stated ultrafilter and well-founded first set ultrapowers. This is not full premouse iterability and does not produce its embedding hypothesis.

The [OWR target](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2014/02), [Cheng–Schindler base and full sharp coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.04000v1), and [Sami forcing-free route](https://doi.org/10.4064/fm-160-2-153-159) are credited. The classical ZF theorem, full fine-structural coding/projective definability and stated HP/Silver dependencies remain cited premises; they are not independently reconstructed. Full countable iterability, including successor and direct-limit well-foundedness, is never replaced by a finite or first-ultrapower condition.

## Review limits and publication boundary

AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. No novelty, current-open certification, complete weak-base proof or countermodel, unrestricted absoluteness, or new coding theorem is claimed.

The entire finite-computation sections and private artifact/history identities are omitted. Programs, results/certificates, fixtures, dataset contents, third-party source bodies and private coordination material are excluded without prose substitution. Every mathematical proof and qualification remains complete. Public scholarly metadata records source dependence, PDF byte identities, and actual retrieval/inspection limitations. Sami's audit reopening returned 403; already retained bytes were inspected. Edition preparation performs no new scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature search.

Exactly six files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002481/. QUEUE.md and every unrelated entry are unchanged. This remains substantive attempt 1/5; editorial preparation adds no proof turn or historical reset.

Strict local replay and independent/native Git object checks establish packaging integrity only, not mathematical truth, remote publication or CI success. Draft publication only; no merge, release, DOI or outside outreach.
